svg.title: Noble Advisory Group | M01 Architectural Bridge | Subtle Directional Fade
svg.desc: Editable cable-stayed bridge with sculpted pylon, patinated-teal deck and selective atmospheric masks. West deck and stays retain their architectural presence; eastern stays softly recede toward the viewport. Nine named Inkscape layers, native vector paths, no embedded raster images.

linearGradient.data-label: Cables fade most strongly near the editorial column
Underside maintains readable depth across left span; subtly increases near tower
Teal visible from page edge; continuity stronger than cable detail
Hardware fades less than cable cores, preserving identifiable mounts
Independent attached contact shadow, softer at far-left but never fully lost

g.inkscape:label: 07 · Cable anchor hardware and tower sockets
